title: Weighted Bruhat paths characterize Schubert smoothness
author: Mihalcea, Leonardo C.; Naruse, Hiroshi; Su, Changjian

primary_locator.required_new_core: complete Segre-MacPherson localization/path recursion, equivariant CSM multiplicity of Richardson varieties and smoothness criterion, Lambda-Bruhat graph definitions and weights

difficulty_reason: The author argument constructs weighted Bruhat-path expressions for Segre–MacPherson localization and relates them to the smoothness criterion through equivariant multiplicities.
